v.t: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
